ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within 30 days after such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 17 imposes exit duties only on us, so we added a vendor-side exit paragraph: transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter. If six months is difficult we can work with 90 days of assistance plus the same 30-day export.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 17(d) requiring Garman transition assistance, 30-day data return in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion
